deposit_metadata.title: BioInterfaceOS v0.1.3-r10.38: provenance-grounded biointerface proteomics analysis framework
deposit_metadata.description: Immutable external-handoff software snapshot for public paper-data reproduction, adoption and protected-evaluator coordination. The scientific candidate remains v0.1.3-r10.32 and all external evidence gates remain explicit.

upload_instructions: Upload the exact archive and sidecar from the KAUST path or an independently hash-verified copy.
Record the archive service DOI, version DOI, immutable record URL and upload timestamp.
Read back the archived manifest bytes and archive bytes; compare both SHA-256 values exactly.
Only after authenticated read-back may doi_archived be changed to true and CITATION.cff be updated.
claim_boundary: This is a deposit preparation artifact, not a DOI or archive receipt. GitHub Release and KAUST archive do not close doi_archived or scientific_submission_ready.
